_comment: Synthetic, public fixture corpus for retrieval evals. Fictional energy platform 'gridflow' plus a neighbouring project 'billing-svc' (isolation checks) and team-wide shared rules. Keys are stable aliases used by queries.json; real node ids are assigned at load time.

nodes.label: Store meter readings in TimescaleDB hypertables
nodes.text: Raw 15-minute meter readings go into a TimescaleDB hypertable partitioned by time with 1-day chunks. Plain PostgreSQL tables degraded badly past 500M rows.

nodes.label: Compress readings chunks older than 7 days
nodes.text: Compression policy on the readings hypertable with segmentby meter_id and orderby ts desc, applied to chunks older than 7 days. Gives roughly 12x storage reduction.

nodes.label: Late-arriving data failed on frozen chunks
nodes.text: Meters that reconnect after days send backlog for periods that were already compacted; those writes failed with lock errors. We added a decompress, write, recompress path and moved the policy run to 02:00.

nodes.label: Keep raw interval data for 3 years for regulatory audit
nodes.text: The regulator requires three years of raw interval data. A retention policy drops chunks older than 3 years; aggregated data is kept indefinitely.

nodes.label: Continuous aggregates for hourly and daily consumption
nodes.text: Hourly and daily consumption and generation totals come from TimescaleDB continuous aggregates refreshed every 15 minutes instead of ad-hoc GROUP BY queries.

nodes.label: Recalculation jobs run on a single scheduler instance
nodes.text: One Quartz scheduler node runs every recalculation job sequentially to avoid concurrent writes.

nodes.label: Distribute recalculation jobs over RabbitMQ work queues
nodes.text: Recalculation jobs are published to a RabbitMQ work queue and consumed by several workers with prefetch 1. Replaces the single scheduler node.

nodes.label: Blocking heartbeat caused duplicate processing
nodes.text: The liveness ping shared a thread with the batch step; under database pressure it stalled, the broker assumed the consumer was dead and handed the message to another worker. Moved the ping to its own non-blocking thread.

nodes.label: Recalculation batches are idempotent per meter and interval
nodes.text: Results are upserted keyed by meter_id and interval_start and checkpoints are persisted, so a redelivered message becomes a no-op.

nodes.label: Keycloak is the single identity provider
nodes.text: All web UIs and APIs authenticate through Keycloak using OpenID Connect; services validate the JWT audience claim.

nodes.label: Field-level authorization is enforced in the backend
nodes.text: Hiding a field in the UI is not access control. API serializers filter fields by role and the check is tested on both the UI and the direct API path.

nodes.label: Secrets are resolved from Azure Key Vault
nodes.text: Application configuration resolves secrets from Azure Key Vault at startup. Existing property sources keep working as a fallback; a local .env file is allowed only for development.

nodes.label: Rotated credentials were not picked up until restart
nodes.text: Values are read once at boot, so after a rotation the service kept the stale database password until it was restarted. Added a refresh endpoint.

nodes.label: Liquibase changesets for every schema change
nodes.text: Every schema change ships as a Liquibase changeset applied to all customer databases, with contexts per customer. Applied changesets are never edited.

nodes.label: Editing an applied changeset broke deploys on 12 environments
nodes.text: Someone fixed a typo in an already applied changeset; the checksum mismatch stopped the rollout on twelve customer environments. Fix forward with a new changeset instead.

nodes.label: Customer environment lifecycle automated through Azure DevOps and Kubernetes
nodes.text: An internal platform creates, upgrades and retires customer environments by calling Azure DevOps pipelines and the Kubernetes API.

nodes.label: Day-ahead forecast available by 10:00 local time
nodes.text: Traders need the day-ahead generation forecast published by 10:00 local time every day, including weekends.

nodes.label: Revised workflow lost the last interval of every page
nodes.text: The new pipeline returned slightly lower totals than the legacy one. An interval-by-interval comparison showed an off-by-one in pagination that dropped the final row of each page.

nodes.label: Spring AI with per-tenant provider routing
nodes.text: Assistant features use Spring AI. Ollama serves local development, vLLM serves on-prem tenants, and the provider is selected per tenant.

nodes.label: Customer data stays on approved model hosts
nodes.text: Consumption and personal data of customers may only be processed by models running on-prem or locally. Hosted third-party model APIs are limited to code and public documentation.

nodes.label: RAG answers missed tables split across chunks
nodes.text: Fixed-size chunking cut tariff tables in half, so answers quoted incomplete rows. Switched to structure-aware chunking that keeps tables intact.

nodes.label: Centralized logging in ELK with a correlation id per request
nodes.text: All services ship structured JSON logs to Elasticsearch through Logstash; every request carries a correlation id propagated across RabbitMQ messages.

nodes.label: Meter list page shows the last reading timestamp
nodes.text: UI tweak: the meter list displays when the latest reading arrived, formatted in the user's time zone.

nodes.label: Compress frontend images as WebP
nodes.text: Converted dashboard PNG assets to WebP which cut page weight by 40 percent.

nodes.label: Team lunch moved to Thursday
nodes.text: Friday lunch clashed with the release window, so it moved to Thursday.

nodes.label: Invoice totals rounded half-even to 2 decimals
nodes.text: Billing rounds invoice line totals with banker's rounding (half-even) to two decimals before summing.

nodes.label: Billing events on Kafka with 7 day retention
nodes.text: Billing publishes invoice and payment events to the Kafka topic billing.events with seven days of retention.

nodes.label: Billing reads meter readings from the nightly export
nodes.text: Billing never queries the readings hypertable directly; it consumes the nightly meter readings export file.

nodes.label: Java 21 and Spring Boot 3 baseline for backend services
nodes.text: All new and upgraded backend services target Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.

nodes.label: Blameless postmortem within 5 working days of an incident
nodes.text: Every production incident gets a blameless written postmortem within five working days.
